title: Microsoft november security updates
leadParagraph: Microsoft has released updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in Microsoft software including:
contentHtml:
Microsoft has released updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in Microsoft software including:

  • Windows
  • Microsoft Exchange Server
  • Microsoft Office

TT-CSIRT encourages users and administrators to review the following releases from Microsoft and apply the necessary updates:

  • November 2022 Security Update Guide
  • Deployment Information
